Question 1

The equation a2+8a=18 can be written in the form (a+p)2=q. Find p+q, and solve the equation.

a
 p+q=35,a=−4−34
b
 p+q=38,a=4+34
c
 p+q=−38,a=−4±35
d
 p+q=−35,a=−4±34
e
 p+q=38,a=−4±34
